fusions.name: Shaken Loose
fusions.desc: Shakes loose 5 quills in a wide spread, each dealing 10 damage to the first enemy it meets within 6 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Finest Needle
fusions.desc: A hair-fine needle deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Strand Snare
fusions.desc: Lays a snare of quilled strands at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and when an enemy comes within 2 tiles it closes and deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Coat of Bristles
fusions.desc: Conjures a coat of stiff quills: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 8%, 15% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your maximum health rises by 10.
